author: James (IrwinJam)
method: Partcl M3D challenge's MIT-licensed negotiated reference router generates a legal in-memory seed directly from the raw benchmark; the local source-aware optimizer then applies hard refinement and bounded large-neighborhood search in the same measured run. No precomputed solution route is read.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (8 physical cores, 16 logical threads), Microsoft Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview, version 10.0.26340, 16440479744 bytes RAM (15.31 GiB), CPU-only
